'''Witch doctor''' was a title given to certain [[Araquia]]n tribe members. during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[T'Jaleq Kith'Araquia]] served as his tribe's witch doctor.
